status: Acceptance criteria declared before the first autonomous grasp or assembly
policy_boundary: Astra uses movement and sensor APIs plus nominal robot, fixture and part design calibration. No live task-object truth or privileged physics QA inputs.
required_sequence: Left fingers grasp the notched half of the brass cavity
Right fingers grasp the short circular boss of the aluminum sleeve
Coarse alignment followed by fine alignment using sensor feedback
Partial insertion while the cavity is still held
Left fingers release and retract, close, then push the cavity farther
Only the notched section remains exposed outside the sleeve
prohibited_shortcuts: Teleporting bodies or robot joints during execution
Fixed joints, welded grasps, attachment helpers or hidden object following
Using fixture grasp tests as proof of autonomous assembly
Using a reached command status alone as proof of task success

stability_gate.required_evidence: Command audit and sensor images for every stage, plus independent geometry scoring after the controller has stopped. Privileged scoring is not returned to the operating policy.

friction_qualification.claim_limit: Simulation success cannot establish real TPU friction or hardware performance.
